**sdd/issue-599-adr-0023-citation-gap/spec**

Spec for issue-599-adr-0023-citation-gap. File: openspec/changes/issue-599-adr-0023-citation-gap/spec.md (worktree /home/gandalf/IA/brain-issue-599). No capability added/modified (proposal Capabilities section is empty) — full spec of this change's own acceptance surface, flat spec.md following issue-590-adr-0018-gitlab-fragment precedent.

REQ-599-1 — No unresolved ADR-0023 citation remains in the scanned surface. The three reworded lines (MASTER-PLAN-1.0.md ~72, ~93; brain-v2-epic-plan.md ~114) MUST NOT leave a bare uppercase ADR-0023 token matching CITATION_RE = /ADR-(\d{4})(?!\d)/g. Since 0023 stays RESERVED (no file at brain/project/decisions/adr-0023-*.md), reword must avoid the bare token, not just resolve it differently. Scenarios: e2e scan against reworded MASTER-PLAN-1.0.md finds no unresolved-citation for 0023; e2e scan against reworded brain-v2-epic-plan.md finds no unresolved-citation for 0023.

REQ-599-2 — Reworded lines stay truthful. Each MUST state: draft exists at brain-drafts/adr-0023-sdd-role-port.md, number 0023 is RESERVED (not promoted), #312 is the tracking ticket. Scenarios: reader of either MASTER-PLAN line finds draft path + reserved status + #312, never a claim the ADR exists; brain-v2-epic-plan.md reworded line stays Spanish-language while carrying the same three facts.

REQ-599-3 — Registry deletions and all three rewordings land together; full suite green. Both KNOWN_GAPS entries — (docs/inbox/MASTER-PLAN-1.0.md, '0023') and (docs/inbox/brain-v2-epic-plan.md, '0023') — MUST be deleted in the same change as all three rewordings. npm test MUST pass both the resolution check and the staleness guard ("no registry entry outlives the citation it exempts"). Scenarios: partial rewording (one MASTER-PLAN line only) with both entries deleted fails resolution check; full rewording without deleting entries fails staleness guard; full rewording + deletion passes both.

REQ-599-4 — Nothing else changes. MUST NOT create/modify any ADR file under brain/project/decisions/, MUST NOT edit brain-drafts/adr-0023-sdd-role-port.md, MUST NOT edit .gitlab-ci.yml, MUST NOT touch any brain/ source beyond test/adr-citation-resolves.e2e.test.mjs. Scenario: committed diff touches exactly docs/inbox/MASTER-PLAN-1.0.md, docs/inbox/brain-v2-epic-plan.md, test/adr-citation-resolves.e2e.test.mjs and nothing else.

Grounded against tree: CITATION_RE and KNOWN_GAPS confirmed in test/adr-citation-resolves.e2e.test.mjs lines 50, 145-150. MASTER-PLAN-1.0.md line 72 "M5 | Role-as-port (C) | #312 + ADR-0023 (draft in `brain-drafts/`)" and line 93 "#312 · ADR-0023 (draft)." brain-v2-epic-plan.md line 114 "Ratificar **ADR-0023** (promover el draft a `decisions/` + HOME.md)."
